caption: The drawing depicts a single, large jug with a handle on its left side, rendered mostly in shades of light brown and gray to represent its ceramic material. The jug has a bulbous body and a short, narrow neck with a small mouth. On the right side of the jug, there is a decorative blue pattern composed of swirling lines and leaf-like shapes, partially shown on the jug itself. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a close-up detail of this blue decoration, enclosed in a square box, showing the intricate curves and motifs in various shades of blue. Near the bottom left, inside a rectangle, the text “RIEDINGER & CAIRE, POUGHKEEPSIE, N.Y.” is written in capital letters. The number “2” is written just above this rectangle. The artist's signature, “Yolande DeLasser,” appears at the bottom right corner of the image. The drawing is bordered by a simple, thin line rectangular frame. The overall color palette consists mainly of neutral tones for the jug and vivid blue for the decorative accent.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
